lede: (the khadi stills become specimen sheets: the photograph mounted with paper corners, the brand's watercolour sprig and line vine pressed across the mount, a label with the listing's figures, and the referent named the way a botanist would.)
idea: The Long Afternoon was the quietest volume — jewellery on khadi and clay with a shirt button or a cardamom pod for scale. The first overlays talked over it. This pass treats each still as a pressed specimen: black photo corners, a ruled label with the piece's name in Velista and its figures in italic, a dotted leader from the referent to its name (Elettaria cardamomum for the pod, Button, 11mm for the button), the site's own sprig and vine laid across the mount with a real shadow, and a small round stamp carrying the brand flower. Restraint is the layout: the jury's word for the Oreo print work this year, and the right one here.
type: The mount is white with 14px margins on a paper ground made from the site's faint floral wallpaper multiplied at 55%. The label is a 1.5px ruled box: a mono eyebrow in oxblood, the name in Velista at up to 64px, three or four rows of Cormorant italic with small mono keys, and the stamp at 112px rotated 12 degrees. The referent leader is a dashed quadratic curve in oxblood with a haloed italic label.
review: Verification: L1, L3, L6 and L9 checked against their listings and photographs; the textured hoop's copy was rewritten from the listing's own words (alternating fluted discs, clusters of clear stones) after the volume's old caption described openwork instead. Five of the volume's nine plates were passed over for stock — the solitaire studs (1), the gold serpentine (inactive), the baguette bracelet, the pearl reverie and the molten hoop (all inactive) — so a fifth plate was generated tonight in the volume's language: the Toggle Link Chain on khadi with a mother-of-pearl button. Pass 1: the florals sat small and pale. Pass 2: sprig and vine enlarged to cross the mount's corners, their contrast raised, small brand petals added at the label's corner.
verdict: specimen 01, the braided hoop with the button, is the lead; the chain is the one to run at spend.
